description: Start COMMAND, and kill it if still running after DURATION.

option.name: --foreground
tip: when not running timeout directly from a shell prompt, allow COMMAND to read from the TTY and get TTY signals; in this mode, children of COMMAND will not be timed out

option.name: --kill-after
tip: also send a KILL signal if COMMAND is still running this long after the initial signal was sent

option.name: --preserve-status
tip: exit with the same status as COMMAND, even when the command times out

option.name: --signal
tip: specify the signal to be sent on timeout; SIGNAL may be a name like 'HUP' or a number; see 'kill -l' for a list of signals

option.name: --verbose
tip: diagnose to stderr any signal sent upon timeout
